title: AMX UsageReport
description: AMA -> AMS usage report (docs/AMX-DESIGN.md §6.5). Emitted on the 5-minute schedule, on an AMS RequestReport / REST :refresh-usage, or alongside a switch. AMA does not poll the usage API directly; this is a re-serialization of the tsamx cache read via `tsamx list --json`. JSON mirror of amx.v1.UsageReport in contracts/proto/amx.proto.

schemaVersion.description: Report envelope version. Incremented only on breaking changes.

generatedAt.description: When AMA built this report (UTC, RFC 3339).

trigger.description: schedule = 5-minute poll; ams_query = RequestReport / :refresh-usage; switch = emitted with a switch event.

inResponseToCommandId.description: AmsCommand.command_id being answered. Required in practice when trigger is ams_query.

activeAccount.description: Account currently holding ~/.claude/.credentials.json (D2: exactly one active). Absent when the pool is empty or no credential is installed.

accounts.description: Every account present on this agent, whatever its allocation status.

allocationStatus.description: AMS-authoritative allocation status projected onto local reality (§5.2).

usageWindow.description: One binding window's utilization. The switch decision uses the max of the two windows (§2.2).

quotaWindow.description: Provider-generalized utilization window (P2b). Self-describing via id + windowMinutes so consumers label/order windows without hardcoding a provider's window set. claude ids: five_hour (windowMinutes 300), seven_day (10080).

model.description: Model identity for a per-model scoped weekly window (usage.scopedWindows). Empty/absent for the positional windows entries. tsamx emits it as the scoped item's name.

spend.description: Pay-as-you-go spend against a monthly cap (tsamx spend). Additive and informational; it never feeds the switch decision or poolSummary.

provider.description: Account provider (P3). Absent or empty means "claude" for reports from agents that predate the field.

isCurrent.description: True for the single account whose credential is installed right now.

windows.description: Generalized window list (P2b). Dual-recorded alongside fiveHour/sevenDay during migration; ordered by windowMinutes ascending.

scopedWindows.description: Per-model scoped weekly windows (tsamx scoped). Kept separate from windows so a per-model limit never feeds the switch/poolSummary math; each entry names its model in quotaWindow.model.

usageFetchedAt.description: Age of the tsamx cache entry this row was read from, not the time of this report.
